name: Imouto Jiru
source: Akira's father, an archeologist, has remarried, giving him a new stepmother and three stepsisters, Yuki, Nana and Miu. While on his honeymoon, Akira's father makes an archeological find and decides to stay on site in order to supervise and leaving Akira at home alone with his new family members. After being discovered in bed with Yukie, his stepmother, Akira finds a box containing a scroll and three bottles. Using the knowledge his father taught to him, he reads the Sumarian language on the scroll and finds himself in a contract with the goddess Inana, who tells him to collect the love juices of his sisters in the bottles before the next full moon or else a terrible horror will befall him.
translation: Akira的父亲是一位考古学家，他再婚了，给他带来了新的继母和三个继姐妹：Yuki、Nana和Miu。在蜜月期间，阿基拉的父亲做出了一项考古发现，并决定留在现场监督，并把阿基拉独自留在家里和他的新家庭成员在一起。晃被发现与继母由纪惠躺在床上后，发现了一个盒子，里面装有卷轴和三个瓶子。利用父亲传授给他的知识，他阅读了卷轴上的苏玛利亚语，发现自己与女神伊娜娜签订了一份契约，伊娜娜告诉他在下一个满月之前将姐妹们的爱情汁液收集到瓶子里，否则可怕的恐怖就会降临到他身上。
